newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon says Israel is against Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon says Israel is against Mideast peace.

text.p: Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri on Wednesday slammed the Israeli government, saying it was against Middle East peace.
"Frankly, I cannot say that the Israeli actions are not encouraging peace. I can comfortably say they are against the peace process," he told state-run television Teleliban.

Hariri's remarks came hours after Crown Prince Hassan of Jordan failed in talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem to persuade Israel to end sanctions it imposed on Palestinians after a double suicide bombing.
The June 30 bombing, which killed 13 people in a Jerusalem street market, has raised tensions in the Middle East.
After the attack, the deadliest against Israelis in a year, Netanyahu suspended a resumption of Israeli-Palestinian talks at committee level on so-called confidence-building measures.
Israeli forces and their local militia allies occupy a security zone in southern Lebanon.
